tool.name: itBins
tool.description: curate metagenome-assembled genomes using GC content, coverage and taxonomy
tool.command: sed #if $advanced.dastool_column -e "s|__DASTOOL_COLUMN__|\$(head -n 1 '$bins' | cut -f $advanced.dastool_column)|" #else -e "s|__DASTOOL_COLUMN__|Bin|" #end if #if $advanced.ubin_column -e "s|__UBIN_COLUMN__|\$(head -n 1 '$bins' | cut -f $advanced.ubin_column)|" #else -e "s|__UBIN_COLUMN__|curated|" #end if '$tasks_template' > 'tasks.json' && itbins -b '$bins' -g '$genes' -o 'itBins_output.tsv' --estimate 'itBins_estimate.tsv' -s 'itBins_summary.tsv' --log-to-stderr -t 'tasks.json' #if str($advanced.scaffold_prefix).strip() --scaff_prefix '$advanced.scaffold_prefix' #end if #if str($advanced.bin_prefix).strip() --bin_prefix '$advanced.bin_prefix' #end if

param.name: bins
param.label: Bin overview table
param.help: Tab-separated table with a header and the columns scaffold, length, GC, coverage, taxonomy and the column with the bin assignments. It is the same overview file that is used by uBin.

param.name: genes
param.label: Single copy gene table
param.help: Comma-separated table with a header, the column scaffolds and one column per single copy gene. Contigs without single copy genes must be listed with zeros.

param.name: dastool_column
param.label: Column with the uncurated bin assignments
param.help: Column of the overview table that contains the bin names of the uncurated bins, e.g. the bin column of a DAS Tool result. If no column is selected, the column named Bin is used.

param.name: ubin_column
param.label: Column with previously curated bin assignments
param.help: Column of the overview table that contains bin assignments of an earlier curation. Leave empty if the table has no such column, e.g. for the first curation of a binning.

param.name: scaffold_prefix
param.label: Prefix for scaffold names
param.help: Prefix attached to the scaffold names in the output, e.g. a sample name followed by an underscore. Useful when the output of several samples is combined.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: bin_prefix
param.label: Prefix for bin names
param.help: Prefix attached to the bin names in the output, e.g. a sample name followed by an underscore. Useful when the output of several samples is combined.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

section.name: curation
section.title: Curation Settings
section.help: Settings of the individual curation tasks. The defaults are the settings that itBins uses when it is run without a task file.

param.name: min_runs
param.label: Minimum number of curation runs
param.help: Number of curation runs a bin has to pass before the best result is accepted; 0 lets itBins decide.

param.name: max_runs
param.label: Maximum number of curation runs
param.help: Upper limit for the number of curation runs per bin; 0 lets itBins decide.

param.name: completeness_cutoff
param.label: Completeness cutoff
param.help: Bins with a lower estimated completeness are removed.

param.name: contamination_cutoff
param.label: Contamination cutoff
param.help: Bins with a higher estimated contamination are removed.

param.name: eukarya_cutoff
param.label: Eukaryotic fraction cutoff
param.help: Contigs with at least this fraction of eukaryotic marker genes are removed as eukaryotic contamination.

param.name: gc_radius
param.label: GC content radius
param.help: Half width of the GC content window (in percent) used to restrict a bin to its GC content peak.

param.name: coverage_radius
param.label: Coverage radius
param.help: Half width of the coverage window (in fold coverage) used to restrict a bin to its coverage peak.

param.name: coverage_position_radius
param.label: Coverage position radius
param.help: Half width of the coverage window as a fraction of the coverage of the bin, an additional limit for bins with a high coverage.

param.name: taxonomy_drop_level
param.label: Taxonomic level for outlier removal
param.help: Rank at which contigs with a different taxonomy are removed from a bin, counted from the domain (1 = domain, 2 = phylum, ...).

param.name: remainder_suffix
param.label: Suffix for remainder bins
param.help: Suffix of the bins that are split off a bin.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

tool.help:
**itBins**
itBins is a fast command line tool for the automated curation of metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs). It refines an existing binning using the GC content, the coverage and the taxonomic affiliation of the contigs of each bin. For every bin it tries a series of curation tasks (e.g. removing taxonomic outliers, restricting the bin to the GC and coverage peak of the majority of its contigs, splitting off a remainder bin) and keeps the changes that improve the estimated quality of the bin. Bins that do not reach the minimum completeness are removed.
itBins is the automated counterpart of the interactive bin curation tool uBin and uses the same input files.
-----
**Input**
- **Bin overview table**: tab-separated table with a header and the columns
| column | content | | --- | --- | | `scaffold` | contig name | | `length` | contig length in bp | | `GC` | GC content in percent | | `coverage` | average per-base coverage | | `taxonomy` | taxonomy of the contig, `;`-separated ranks, e.g. `bacteria;Pseudomonadota;...` | | bin column | name of the bin the contig was assigned to, e.g. by DAS Tool |
- **Single copy gene table**: comma-separated table with a header, the column `scaffolds` and one column per single copy gene. The default bacterial (51) and archaeal (38) marker gene sets of itBins must be present. Contigs without single copy genes must still be listed, with zeros.
-----
**Output**
- **Curated bin assignments**: the overview table with the original bin assignments and the new bin assignments of itBins. Contigs that were removed from a bin are assigned to `none`; contigs split off a bin are reported in a new bin with the suffix `_remainder`. - **Bin summary**: completeness, contamination and score of every bin before and after curation, together with the estimated improvement and a flag whether the bin was curated, split or removed. - **Binning success estimation**: fraction of the assembled base pairs and of the single copy marker genes that are assigned to a bin.
-----
**Notes**
- A bin is only kept if its completeness is above the completeness cutoff (0.7 by default) and its contamination below the contamination cutoff (0.1 by default), so an input binning with many low quality bins can lose most of its bins. Both cutoffs and the settings of the individual curation tasks can be changed in the curation settings. - Progress messages are written to stderr; the tool writes no output to stdout. - For a tabular result without the removed contigs, filter the curated bin assignments on the bin column.
